- **Constraint 1:** I filtered out any candidate with Molybdenum (`Mo`) > 3.21 wt%.
- **Constraint 2:** I calculated the alloying cost index for each candidate by taking the sum of the elements' weight percentages multiplied by their respective prices in USD/kg (Fe was excluded). I filtered out any candidate whose cost exceeded 450.
This reduced the candidate pool to 70 strictly feasible recipes.

### 2. Modeling & Training

Ranking the feasible pool according to the highest predicted yield strength provides our final 5 standout candidates.
